message: Initial scaffold population: stack locked (Go/Echo, modernc.org/sqlite, goldmark, argon2id, TS+esbuild plugin); deployment is flexible (Cloudflare Tunnel OR direct droplet — tunnel-only assumption dropped per owner); 5 PRD open questions recorded as pending decisions in context/decisions.md

MVP Go server implemented in server/ (module obsidian-publish/server): Echo v4, pure-Go SQLite (modernc), goldmark render-at-publish, argon2id (t=1,m=64MB,p=4, PHC format), route-scoped HMAC session cookie (1h, resolves PRD open question 14.4), bearer-token /api plane with constant-time compare, 5/min per IP+route sliding-window rate limit, slug validation + reserved routes, user_version schema pin. PUT password semantics agreed with plugin agent: omitted=keep, JSON null or empty string=remove, non-empty=set. Theme endpoint intentionally skipped (v2). build/vet/test all pass; CGO_ENABLED=0 verified.

MVP complete on main: server (19f6b8c) and plugin (96955cd) merged; verified independently (go build/vet/test, npm build + 37/37 vitest) and full e2e smoke passed (401 gate, publish, password gate incl. form-only pre-auth + cookie unlock, list without hash exposure, delete->404)
